definition: Yunhong Wang (Chinese: 王蕴红) is a Chinese computer scientist and image processing researcher focused on the applications of computer vision in biometrics.
details: She is a professor at Beihang University in its School of Computer Science and Engineering, and the director of the Laboratory of Intelligent Recognition and Image Processing and Beijing Key Laboratory of Digital Media.
story: Imagine an art restorer who can spot a single cracked tile in a vast mosaic. What your eyes do without thinking, the machine does one careful layer at a time. The machine learns to see the way we do — starting with shapes and edges, then building up to whole objects and faces. The model looks the way you look at a crowd and finds the one face you know. And that is Yunhong Wang — giving a machine the gift of sight.
